description.value: Vashti Rose is a Port Moody artisan ice cream shop that has been making both dairy and vegan scoops entirely from scratch since 2016, using organic pasteurized milk, cream, and eggs alongside house-made cashew milk for the vegan line. The shop shares a building with Pro Fit Boot Camp on Saint Johns Street and offers an extensive rotating menu of creative flavours, from saffron and rose water to blackberry sage and bourbon hazelnut. A touring cyclist looking for a handcrafted treat on the Tri-Cities route would find both classic and allergy-conscious options here.
